snippet.title: Crimson Seer Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837870/Crimson_Seer/

A new trailer for my game Crimson Seer. A dark fantasy detective adventure where you play as an elf investigator piecing together murders through prophetic visions.

This update showcases a completely overhauled interface: investigations now unfold on your detective’s desk, where you can take notes, connect clues, and follow your own trail of deductions.

Step into the crimson-tinted underworld, study frozen moments in time, and uncover the truth buried beneath layers of magic, murder, and deceit.
